changes.git_diff:
Added graceful degradation for MCP server connection failures:
- Enhanced MCPClient initialization with fallback to empty configuration
- Added individual server connection testing (non-blocking)
- Implemented LLM-only fallback mode when MCP servers fail
- Updated error messages to be more user-friendly with graceful degradation info
- Added testServerConnections method for individual server validation
changes.summary: Implemented comprehensive graceful degradation so the agent works even when MCP servers fail to connect. The system now falls back to LLM-only mode instead of completely failing.
changes.rollback_note: Safe to rollback if graceful degradation causes unexpected behavior. Original error handling was more strict but caused complete failures.
